The fixed first-order vector is(0,i); the reconstructed derivative is(-i*z)*v1+(-i)*v2. Actual classical IVP agreement, frequency evenness, entire square descent INCLUDING ZERO energy and exact physical constant-shift law are proved.

The actual L2 terminal quasi-derivative is jointly entire and NONZERO at every scalar Dirichlet root by the physical determinant-one identity. On H1 Miura inputs, the actual physical terminal derivative equals U(1)*D plus this terminal quasi-derivative. This is proved using actual scalar IVP uniqueness on smooth profiles and H1 norm density. At a root the gauge correction vanishes, giving exact equality with the independently normalized physical L2 terminal derivative, including every complex constant energy shift.

The actual L2 Miura discriminant equals the sum of the actual two fundamental diagonal entries, by the verified H1 trace identity and L2 density. At a Dirichlet root, determinant one gives first diagonal entry=terminal inverse. Thus the prescribed diagonal DIFFERENCE is terminal inverse minus terminal, and its square is EXACTLY discriminant squared minus four. Its sign comes from actual fundamental solutions, not a selected square root.

Every existing real-centered Dirichlet ball supports ALL positive-index analytic NONZERO terminal multipliers. At physical L2 points these equal the SAME original scalar terminal derivative. The already verified common energy labels and original physical L2 density prove equality on ENTIRE COMPLEX overlaps. Gluing therefore gives one analytic nonzero multiplier for EVERY positive index on the EXISTING hillHminusCanonicalDirichletDomain, with no new shrinking or replacement domain.

Independence holds for EVERY valid complex L2 Miura lift u and EVERY complex constant c satisfying Miura(u)=q+inclusion(c), not only the selected balls. A reusable open-set equality lemma for every finite Banach exponent checks continuous equality on the dense one-derivative scalar domain. Apply it on the open inverse image of the common Dirichlet domain under u->Miura(u)-inclusion(c). The H1 comparison and physical L2 terminal identity give equality there, then continuity proves arbitrary-lift equality.

The intrinsic sheet w_n=d_n inverse minus d_n is analytic on the SAME common connected complex domain as ALL energies, actions, squared gaps and action quotients. It agrees with the ACTUAL diagonal fundamental difference for EVERY shifted Miura representation and satisfies w_n squared=Delta(mu_n) squared minus four. The original full real mean-zero physical period-one H-minus-one potentials retain their original ALL-index Dirichlet energy labels, exact derivative normalization and original discriminant in the resulting divisor pairs.
